page_title: CHE 6-0 EVE | Chelsea v Everton 15/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Beto (Everton) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
90+5' Ashley Young (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
90+4' Beto (Everton) is adjudged offside.
90+2' Sean Dyche is forced to make a change. Nathan Patterson is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ben Godfrey (Everton).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' 6 - 0 Ben Chilwell fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) inside the box. He releases a quick shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 6:0.
88' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Deivid Washington (Chelsea) replacing Nicolas Jackson.
88' Substitution. Malo Gusto is replaced by Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea).
87' Dangerous play by Andre Gomes (Everton). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
86' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
80' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Cole Palmer is replaced by Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) coming on for Mykhailo Mudryk.
79' Michael Keane (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Everton will take a throw-in.
78' The resulting corner from Andre Gomes (Everton) is cleared by the defence.
78' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
78' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:7.
77' Everton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
77' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
76' Jack Harrison (Everton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Everton.

74' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
73' Ashley Young (Everton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noni Madueke leaves the pitch and Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) comes on.
70' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) and Mykhailo Mudryk try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
67' Beto (Everton) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
66' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Michael Keane (Everton), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
64' 5 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jordan Pickford into the bottom right corner.
63' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to take the penalty!
61' A player from Everton pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Chelsea.
61' Chelsea have a corner.
61' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
60' Chelsea take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' That's unlucky! Noni Madueke (Chelsea) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
60' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Cole Palmer (Chelsea).
58' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
57' Jarrad Branthwaite is being substituted because of an injury. Sean Dyche sends Michael Keane (Everton) on the pitch.
55' The game is interrupted now, Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

55' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Jordan Pickford guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
54' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Tarkowski (Everton) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It's a throw-in for Chelsea.
51' Ashley Young (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
50' The referee awards a corner and Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes over to take it.
50' Andre Gomes (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Andre Gomes (Everton) tries to find Beto, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
46' Sean Dyche has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nathan Patterson comes on the pitch for Seamus Coleman (Everton).
46' Sean Dyche makes a half-time substitution. Andre Gomes comes on in place of Amadou Onana (Everton).
46' Half-time substitution. Sean Dyche decided to make a change. James Garner (Everton) is replaced by Jack Harrison.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' What a miss! The corner finds Amadou Onana (Everton) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
45+4' The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick.
45+4' An attempted cross from Ashley Young (Everton) is cleared.
45+3' Amadou Onana (Everton) brings an opponent down and Paul Tierney interrupts the game. Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' 4 - 0 Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) meets a perfect cross from Marc Cucurella deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 4:0.
43' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Djordje Petrovic (Chelsea).
42' James Tarkowski (Everton) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players.
41' It seemed like Dwight McNeil (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
41' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Everton out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
40' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
39' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Amadou Onana (Everton) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
39' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
38' 62:38 – the ratio of ball possession.
36' Ashley Young (Everton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
35' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Beto (Everton) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
34' Dwight McNeil (Everton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
33' The Everton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is penalised for a foul. Paul Tierney had a clear view and blows his whistle.

29' 3 - 0 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 3:0.
28' James Garner (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
26' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
25' Chelsea decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
25' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
24' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quickest to intercept the ball.
23' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
22' The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
22' A long ball forward to Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is intercepted.
18' 2 - 0 Cole Palmer (Chelsea) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
18' Great save! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Jordan Pickford.
18' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes a short free kick.
18' Chelsea are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
17' Paul Tierney interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Seamus Coleman (Everton).
16' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Cole Palmer, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Nicolas Jackson plays a short, square pass into the path of Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
11' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
11' Beto (Everton) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
9' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
9' The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.
8' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
8' Dwight McNeil (Everton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' A pass by Noni Madueke (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
5' The ball is cleared after Noni Madueke (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' The free kick from long range, taken by Everton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
1' Chelsea are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
1' Amadou Onana (Everton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mykhailo Mudryk.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Paul Tierney.
